# Correction to the failure reason recorded for attempt 4 at record 46

F5 of the second review at note 49, and the same fault note 42 corrected for
record 23, one record later. The journal is append-only, so record 46 stands as
written and this note is the correction.

**What record 46 says.** "F7: '614.1 is not an instance of int' from
test_every_amount_is_a_whole_number_of_cents".

**What check 40, the RED it cites, actually contains.** "AssertionError: 300.0
is not an instance of <class 'int'> : cost_cents is 300.0". The string 614.1
appears in no check output anywhere in this journal.

**Why it was wrong, and why it is worse than the first one.** 614.1 is a real
figure: it is what `kpi.execution` returned for slice 1 of this ticket's own
journal when the session ran it by hand, minutes before writing the record. It
was copied from what the session had been looking at rather than from the
runner, which is the same class of fault as record 23's, where the figure came
from the solution record's prediction. Note 42 called that "the one thing the
field exists to prevent" and this record repeated it in the next attempt, which
says the correction was written and not learned. The field is a quotation, and
the only safe way to fill it is to read the cited check's captured output and
copy from there.

**What it does not change.** The RED did fail, and the other three failures
record 46 names are in check 40 verbatim: the KeyError on `implementer_task`
four times, "0.4 != 0", and the assertion on "## The two agents". The slice is
not re-proved on this account; the record is corrected so that a reader auditing
it, or SEEN-109 calibrating red_before_green on it, is not looking for a figure
that is not there.
